groups.title: Multi-line comments
groups.note: In Source, or the Source pane of Split.

rows.action: A line number: start picking lines for one comment
A line number while picking: add or remove that line
A line number while picking: add every line from the last clicked one to this one
Across line numbers while picking: add the lines (start on an unpicked line) or remove them (start on a picked one)
Leave line picking: hide the comment box and drop the lines
Save the comment and leave line picking
Hide the comment box but keep the lines; click a line number to bring it back
Move the comment box
With the ⠿ grip focused: move the comment box; Shift takes a bigger step

groups.title: Review
groups.note: Mark the blocks you have read. Keys work when you are not typing and no box is open.

rows.action: Mark or unmark the block in the reading band (under the pointer in pointer Focus mode); after marking, go to the next unreviewed block
Mark or unmark the whole section of that block
Next / previous unreviewed block
The lane beside a block: mark, unmark, or confirm a changed block (○)
The lane: mark or unmark every block between the last clicked lane and this one
The square beside a heading: mark or unmark the whole section
In the comment box: mark the whole blocks touched by the selection or the picked lines
Phone / touch: mark the block in the reading band and go to the next unreviewed one
The progress strip at a pane's right edge: scroll there (mouse only)
A dashed ✓ suggested from your reading time: accept it, marking the block reviewed
Review tab: mark every block with a dashed ✓ reviewed
Open this list (not while typing in a box)
